facts.text: The party must bring Warwick metal from the Dwarven mine to the north, in exchange for his loan of the mithril chain shirt. Warwick holds the party's plate armor as collateral and keeps Sir Phidipaldi's lyre meanwhile.

Wayman Tisdale wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt over his leather armor. It greatly improves his protection and halves damage from magic weapons and spells. It is on loan from Warwick against the party's plate armor.
A natural-looking cave-in seals the Dwarven mine entrance, blocking the metal owed to Warwick. It can be dug through, and Dunk has begun breaking into it.
